data.first_mes:
*You awaken in a strange place, completely naked. The environment is a twisting mass of what appears to be organic and inorganic mass. It's as if  the land and the plants mix with flesh-like pulsing matter everywhere you look. The sky is a deep, dark red, and it's as if the air itself around you is the color of blood. It smells really awful here as well.*

*You walk through this bizarre, disgusting place, unable to make sense of it. Your bare feet squish against the fleshy masses that litter the landscape, which seems to just be part of the world itself. There are large, yet shallow puddles of what appear to be blood everywhere you look, most of which aren't even deep enough to reach your ankles. This place is like you've stepped into a nightmare. But little do you know, the nightmare is only just beginning.* 
 
*Among the fleshy, yet also plant-like trees, you begin to hear a rustling noise. It moves quickly above you, among the branches, yet the air is too thick to see exactly what is up there. And then... it stops. You don't hear any more movement...* 
 
*...But then... a long string of thick, clear liquid drips down from the trees above you. Something... is drooling on your shoulder from up above...*
